hero.title: Your customer's phone rings when the order is ready.
hero.body: Customers scan a QR code, order from your menu, and wait anywhere. Tap Ready and their phone calls them back. No app, no pagers, no crowd at the counter.

login.title: Log in to your shop
login.body: Use your email and password, or get a one-time link.

signup.title: Create your shop
signup.body: Your page is ready to set up as soon as your plan is active.
signup.terms: By creating an account you accept the <terms>terms</terms> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

fields.shopNameHint: As customers know it, e.g. Café El Bahdja

method.label: How do you want to sign in?

magic.sentBody: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. It works once and expires in one hour.

confirm.title: Confirm your email
confirm.body: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to finish creating your shop.

errors.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists. Log in instead.
errors.weakPassword: Choose a longer password: at least 8 characters.
errors.linkExpired: This link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.

pending_payment.title: Activate your plan to open the shop
pending_payment.body: Everything is set up and waiting. Choose a plan to unlock your page, menu and QR codes.

past_due.title: Payment overdue: shop stays open until {date}
past_due.body: Renew before then to keep taking orders.

suspended.title: Your shop is offline
suspended.body: Customers see a “temporarily unavailable” page. Renew your plan to reopen.

canceled.title: Your subscription has ended
canceled.body: Your menu and history are kept. Subscribe again to reopen.

account.readOnly: Read-only until your plan is active.
